title: Unlimited love. Unlimited possibilities.
intro: Every child deserves to feel valued. Every family deserves the opportunity to thrive. Together, we can help make that possible.

children.text: A little support can
open a world of possibility.
We’re here to help children and families move forward.

Agape Unlimited Foundation is a community-driven foundation serving children and families in Georgia, United States. Our mission brings together education, mentorship, practical resources, and community connections to help people move forward.
We believe every child deserves to feel valued, every family deserves an opportunity to thrive, and every community deserves access to hope and support.
The future we believe in
Stronger communities where every child has the opportunity to reach their full potential and every family has the support needed to create a better future.
Many ways to care.
One shared purpose.
Meeting people where they are.
Helping them see what could be next.
Explore the areas that guide our work.
Education & academic support
Creating room to learn, grow, and discover what comes next through access to educational resources and academic support.
Scholarships & career opportunities
Opening pathways to continued education and career exploration so that financial barriers do not define a young person’s future.
Family assistance & support
Connecting families with supportive resources and meaningful relationships that help them move toward greater stability.
Youth mentorship
Building caring connections that help young people feel seen, discover their strengths, and imagine new possibilities.
Food & basic needs assistance
Helping connect children and families with food and essential resources, with dignity and respect at every step.
Housing & community resources
Connecting families with housing information and community resources that may help address barriers to a stable home.
Workforce & life-skills development
Supporting practical skills, confidence, and preparation for work and everyday life.
Accessibility & inclusion
Working toward opportunities and supportive spaces where people of different abilities can participate and belong.
Youth leadership & empowerment
Encouraging young people to use their voices, build confidence, and take an active role in their communities.
Community partnerships & outreach
Bringing people and organizations together to share resources, build relationships, and strengthen community support.
These are areas our programs and initiatives may include. Availability will depend on resources and community partnerships.

want to help.

possibilities.
We work to identify barriers affecting underserved children and families and connect them with meaningful resources, relationships, and opportunities that can change the trajectory of their lives.
We may not be able to change every circumstance, but we can help change what is possible.

It’s more than our name.
It’s how we choose to show up.

When a child is given an opportunity,

There’s a place for you
in this work.
We will continue to show up, serve with love, build meaningful partnerships, and create opportunities for children and families who too often find themselves overlooked.

Agape Unlimited Foundation is a community-driven foundation serving children and families in Georgia, United States. Our mission brings together education, mentorship, practical resources, and community connections to help people move forward.
Our work starts with listening to community needs. We aim to connect children and families with resources, relationships, and opportunities, guided by the support and partnerships available.
The future we believe in.
Stronger communities where every child has the opportunity to reach their full potential and every family has the support needed to create a better future.
Love without limits.
Support with purpose.
Agape means love without limits. That belief shapes how we serve: with compassion, dignity, and a commitment to seeing the potential in every person.

We don’t simply want to help. We want to create possibilities. Our work brings together education, everyday support, and community relationships to help children and families look toward a stronger tomorrow.
We may not be able to change every circumstance,
but we can help change what is possible.
A stronger community starts with connection.
Bring your questions, your ideas, and your willingness to help. There’s room for you here.

title: Love without limits. In everything we do.
intro: Agape is more than our name. It’s how we choose to show up for children, families, and one another.

children.text: Compassion
We serve people with dignity, respect, and understanding.
Care begins with listening. We aim to meet children and families where they are, with kindness and respect for their experiences.
Empowerment
We don’t just help people get through today; we help them prepare for tomorrow.
Support should make room for confidence, skills, and independence. Our purpose is to help people see and pursue possibilities for their own futures.
Opportunity
We believe access can change a life.
Education, mentorship, and meaningful resources can open doors. We work to connect people with opportunities that might otherwise feel out of reach.
Integrity
We lead with honesty, accountability, and transparency.
Trust matters in every relationship. We are committed to communicating honestly about our work, our resources, and what is possible.
Inclusion
Every child, family, and individual deserves to be seen, heard, and valued.
Belonging should not depend on background or ability. Accessibility and respect for each person guide the opportunities and relationships we seek to build.
Community
Lasting change happens when we work together.
Families, volunteers, and community partners each bring something valuable. Strong relationships help turn individual acts of care into shared possibility.
People at the heart
of possibility.
When a child is given an opportunity, a family is given hope. And when families become stronger, communities become stronger.
Put care into action.
Bring your compassion, your experience, and your ideas. Together, we can make room for possibility.

title: Your message, handled with care.
intro: Here’s what happens to the information you share through this website.

children.text: Contact messages

The contact form asks for your name, email address, a topic, and a message. You can also provide an organization name. When message delivery is available, this information is sent to the foundation’s configured email inbox through Resend, an email delivery service.

This website does not save contact messages to a website database. Messages that are sent may remain in the foundation’s inbox and the email provider’s systems. If you prepare a message but do not send it, the form does not submit that information.
Spam protection and technical information

The form includes an automated spam check and limits repeated requests. Hosting services may process technical information, including your IP address and request details, to operate the website and prevent abuse. Contact message text is not intentionally written to application logs.
Donations

Online donation links take you to the foundation’s configured donation provider. Payment information is entered on that provider’s website and handled under its own privacy practices. This website does not collect card numbers or process payments.
What to include in a message
Please share only what we need to understand your question. Avoid sending passwords, payment information, or sensitive records through the form.
Questions about your information
Contact the foundation
to ask about a message you have sent or request help with your information.
